milestones.title: Sprint 1 - Data and the model in R
milestones.description: Goal: FDIC Call Report data fetched and checked, an R package that builds features and labels, fits the early-warning model on 2007-2009 and evaluates it out of time on 2011-2012 against a one-ratio baseline.

milestones.title: Sprint 2 - The model in three SQL engines
milestones.description: Goal: MySQL, SQL Server and Oracle each compute the features and scores with their own SQL, tested in the engine where it has a framework, and proven equal to R bank by bank.

milestones.description: Goal: CI runs R CMD check and all three engines, the results and their limits are documented, release v1.0.0.

issues.title: Scaffold: Python and R packages, generated local passwords, CI with lint, types, tests and a secret scan
issues.milestone: Sprint 1 - Data and the model in R
issues.body:
As the owner, I want a project that checks itself on every push.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Python package with ruff, mypy, pytest; an R package skeleton
- [ ] database passwords generated into a git-ignored .env, never typed or committed
- [ ] CI: lint, types, unit tests, gitleaks, pip-audit

issues.title: FDIC Call Report data: financials 2006-2013, failures, institutions, with a manifest and checks
issues.milestone: Sprint 1 - Data and the model in R
issues.body:
As an analyst, I want the exact data every number came from.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] every page fetched, row counts equal to the API's totals, retries on 429/5xx
- [ ] a manifest with the API snapshot name and the sha256 of each file
- [ ] data checks: unique (bank, quarter) keys, missing values, failures matched to filings

issues.title: R package bankwarn: features, labels with a publication lag, the logistic model and its export
issues.milestone: Sprint 1 - Data and the model in R
issues.body:
As a credit-risk analyst, I want the model in a tested R package.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] CAMELS-style features with four-quarter changes, defined once
- [ ] a bank-quarter is positive if the bank failed within a year of its data becoming public; earlier failures are dropped
- [ ] features clipped at training quantiles; coefficients and bounds exported with full precision
- [ ] testthat tests, covr coverage, lintr, R CMD check

issues.title: Out-of-time evaluation against a one-ratio baseline
issues.milestone: Sprint 1 - Data and the model in R
issues.body:
As a supervisor, I want to know whether the model beats the obvious rule on years it never saw.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] train on 2007-2009 report dates, test on 2011-2012, 2010 left out
- [ ] AUC with a bank-level bootstrap interval, Brier score, a 100-bank watch list's recall and precision
- [ ] the same for 'lowest equity ratio first'

issues.milestone: Sprint 2 - The model in three SQL engines
issues.body:
As a model-risk reviewer, I want proof the deployed SQL is the validated model.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] the same banks in each test quarter; scores within 1e-9 of R's
- [ ] load and scoring times per engine, labelled as one machine
